items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: And that person, Mrs. Glasner, she became my best friend, and I'd run an orchestra and everything, she was the one that helped me to get my recordings and everything.

ctx.x: They are a very cultured people. They were very congenial. There were no symptoms of the last war, World War I outside of Mrs. Glasner's original feeling, which was a personal thing.

I had a really wonderful time in Germany, and not only I but the orchestra in general, and all the musicians -- we had quite a few French musicians and from everywhere else, in Berlin, and they all had a wonderful time.
